body: Most tasks don't need an AI agent. Here's how to tell.

Chatbot, workflow, agent: three levels, and most people jump straight to the third.
A chatbot answers. A workflow follows your steps. An agent chooses its own.
If you can draw the steps on a napkin, build the workflow first.
